guarantees.claim: state_out is always the bitwise XOR of state_done_buf[0] and state_done_buf[1].
u_prim_state_done_muxed connects state_done_buf as a registered (buffered) copy of {state_done_muxed[1], state_done_muxed[0]}.

assumptions.claim: NumShares must be equal to 2; the hardcoded indices [1] and [0] in the instance and assign require exactly two shares for correct unmasking.
assumptions.risk: If NumShares != 2, higher-order shares (if any) are ignored, leading to incomplete unmasking which exposes secret information or produces incorrect output.

formal_sketch.consequent: NumShares must be equal to 2; the hardcoded indices [1] and [0] in the instance and assign require exactly two shares for correct unmasking

assumptions.claim: state_done_muxed[0] ^ state_done_muxed[1] must equal the intended unshared AES state value.
assumptions.risk: If the two shares are not complementary, state_out will be incorrect, potentially leaking a masked secret or causing functional failure.

assumptions.claim: prim_buf correctly buffers its input without altering bit values or introducing skew between the two shares.
assumptions.risk: Glitches or timing skew from prim_buf could desynchronize shares, leading to side-channel leakage when unmasked.

formal_sketch.consequent: prim_buf correctly buffers its input without altering bit values or introducing skew between the two shares

uncertain_points.claim: If NumShares can be configured greater than 2, the hardcoded share indices [1] and [0] would ignore higher shares during unmasking.
uncertain_points.risk: Incomplete unmasking could expose intermediate masked values or produce an incorrect plaintext, breaking confidentiality.

formal.consequent: state_out == state_done_buf[0] ^ state_done_buf[1] // excludes higher shares

formal_sketch.consequent: state_out == state_done_buf[0] ^ state_done_buf[1] // excludes higher shares

uncertain_points.claim: Shares state_done_muxed[0] and state_done_muxed[1] must be temporally aligned when presented to prim_buf; misalignment could cause unmasking of values from different clock cycles.
uncertain_points.cond: when share update frequency is not synchronized
uncertain_points.risk: XOR of shares from different cycles may leak correlation information and compromise masking.

formal_sketch.antecedent: when share update frequency is not synchronized
formal_sketch.consequent: Shares state_done_muxed[0] and state_done_muxed[1] must be temporally aligned when presented to prim_buf; misalignment could cause unmasking of values from different clock cycles

uncertain_points.claim: state_out is generated combinationally from state_done_buf; glitches on the share outputs may propagate to the unmasked output without an additional register.
uncertain_points.risk: Glitch propagation could be exploited in power/timing side-channel attacks. A registered output might be intended for better constant-time properties.

formal_sketch.consequent: state_out is generated combinationally from state_done_buf; glitches on the share outputs may propagate to the unmasked output without an additional register

security_implications: state_out is the XOR of two shares, producing the unmasked AES cipher output. If NumShares != 2 or shares are misaligned, unmasking could be incomplete and leak secret information. The combinational unmasking may also propagate glitches if input shares are not stable, posing a side-channel risk. The hardcoded share indices assume exactly two shares; any deviation bypasses the masking protection.
